### [A perfect lunch to enjoy a few tapas and drink a few glasses of good wines](https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g1063737-d8566354-r971700013-Barmutet-Vic_Catalonia.html)

Sep 2024 • Couples

Right in the old town in a small alley not far from the beautiful square, a very pleasant discovery that this small bar and tavern called Barmutet. A comfortable and perfect place to enjoy a glass of vermouth, wine or eat some tapas.

The alley serves as a terrace and probably serves both establishments because you can also go across the street to Més Barmutet, same Owner but more a wine bar.

But Barmutet is the place where we are, with a wide range of tapas and rations, dishes in “grilled” forms, seafood, canned goods and of course vermouth.

A tavern with a beautiful rather original decor with these two rooms. The first with its communal table in the center and the second in the back as a cozy little room.

In the first room, the bar and kitchen on the side.

What will surprise is the impressive display of bottles of vermouth like in few places. So it is unthinkable not to start with a vermouth by specifying your preferences because all have different tastes. Just contemplate the wall of bottles in the second room.

The tapas menu is rather long, so varied with a number of proposals using embers which is rather original and welcome. But also everything classic to just accompany a glass of vermouth. In this respect, we start with a Vermut Bertsolari, prepared from wine, sugar, alcohol and a maceration of different plants where craftsmanship or absinthe stand out, giving a characteristic sweet, bitter and aromatic flavor. A fine and very complex red vermouth, made from wine macerated with 40 plants. The taste in the mouth is very pleasant, slightly sweet but balanced and persistent.

To start al caliu potatoes with Romesco sauce.
Normally under the ashes, it is much better than cooked in water, accompanied by a very good sauce well prepared according to custom. This changes bravas and is much less heavy.

Very good tomato bread with just the right amount of tomato and the olive oil is tasty.

At the suggestion of the waiter, a very nice seafood dish cooked in ember with knives, mussels, scallops and clams.

Then a bit of a surprise with pig cheeks in embers. I thought cheeks would only be prepared in a casserole with usually wine and a very long cooking, but here it is served like a pluma and a little rosé. I imagine it can only be done with this type of cheek because the ox would be too hard.

A bottle of wine with an organic white La Bruixa elaborated by the Wines de la Memòria cellar with the Macabeo and Garnacha Blanca grape varieties in the D.O. Terra Alta.

A perfect lunch to enjoy a few tapas and drink a few glasses of good wines.

##### MUCH MORE THAN A RESTAURANT

At Xinvic, we combine quality ingredients, creative cuisine, and an atmosphere designed for leisurely enjoyment. Whether it's for a special dinner, a meal with friends, or a celebration, we want every visit to become a memorable experience.

## Medieval Bravas

##### A story that became a legend.

Some dishes are created to accompany a meal, while others become part of a restaurant's history. Our Medieval Bravas are one of those that don't go unnoticed.

A unique recipe, a combination of flavors and our own way of understanding good patatas bravas that, over time, have become one of the great symbols of Xinvic.

The recognition came in 2024, when they were chosen as the best patatas bravas in Barcelona. And far from being just a memory, we achieved it again in 2025, proving that a good recipe isn't a matter of luck, but of passion, quality ingredients, and a strong desire to do things right.

Today, our Medieval Bravas are part of the essence of Xinvic. A dish that speaks of us, of our way of cooking, and of that constant quest to transform something as simple as bravas into an experience you'll want to repeat.

Book ahead for weekends; otherwise, this is among the most accessible Michelin-recognised addresses in the Vic area. ## About Barmutet ## Barmutet, Vic: The Verdict If you have already eaten at Barmutet and are wondering whether a return visit is worth it, the short answer is yes — but for different reasons than you might expect. The kitchen does not chase novelty for its own sake. What changes on a second visit is your understanding of how consistently it executes traditional Catalan cooking at a price point (€€) that most comparable kitchens in the region cannot match. Michelin has recognised this consistency with a Plate award in both 2024 and 2025. That two-year recognition is the signal to pay attention to: it tells you the kitchen is not a one-season story. For a first-timer, here is what to expect. Barmutet sits at Carrer de la Ciutat, 2, in the historic centre of Vic, a market town in the Osona comarca roughly equidistant between Barcelona and the Pyrenees. Vic is not a dining destination in the way that Girona or San Sebastián are, which is precisely why a Michelin-recognised address here carries weight. The bar for earning a Plate in a smaller regional city is not lower — if anything, Michelin scrutinises value-for-money more carefully when the local competition is thinner. Barmutet has passed that test twice. The cuisine classification is Traditional, and that framing matters more than it might seem. In a Spanish dining context, Traditional cuisine does not mean safe or uninspired. It means the kitchen anchors itself in technique, product quality, and regional identity rather than conceptual novelty. For Vic, that means working with the Osona region's strengths: the area has a long history of charcuterie production, and the broader Catalan interior larder, seasonal vegetables, pulses, game, and freshwater fish, gives a skilled kitchen significant material to work. Barmutet's Michelin recognition suggests it is making the most of that material with sufficient technical rigour to satisfy an assessor looking for execution, not just authenticity. A 4.4 at that volume is not a statistical outlier, it is a reliable signal that the majority of visitors are leaving satisfied, and that the kitchen's output is consistent rather than erratic. Many restaurants in this tier hold higher averages with far fewer reviews, which makes them harder to trust. Barmutet's volume gives its score credibility. On price, the €€ bracket positions this well below the majority of Michelin-recognised restaurants anywhere in Spain. If your frame of reference is a night at [El Celler de Can Roca in Girona](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/girona/el-celler-de-can-roca) or an afternoon at [Arzak in San Sebastián](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/san-sebastian/arzak), Barmutet is a fraction of the spend for cooking that Michelin has formally acknowledged. That is the value proposition: you are not trading down in quality assessment, you are trading down in price tier. Booking is rated Easy. Vic is not on the international culinary circuit in the way that Barcelona or the Basque Country are, which means walk-in availability is more likely here than at destination restaurants. That said, local demand in a smaller city means weekends fill faster than you would expect, if you have a specific date in mind, booking ahead removes the risk. No phone number or website is available in our records, so the most reliable approach is to contact the venue directly via Google or in person if you are already in Vic. For dining context in Vic, [Boccatti](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/vic/boccatti) offers a seafood-focused alternative, and [VIA](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/vic/via) covers regional cuisine at a similar price point. Both are worth knowing if Barmutet is full or if you want a different register for the same evening. Our [full Vic restaurants guide](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/vic) maps the broader options, and if you are planning a longer stay, the Vic hotels guide, bars guide, wineries guide, and experiences guide give the full picture. For a wider view of traditional cuisine recognised at this level elsewhere in Spain and across the border, [Cave à Vin & à Manger - Maison Saint-Crescent in Narbonne](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/narbonne/cave-a-vin-and-a-manger-maison-saint-crescent) and [Coto de Quevedo Evolución in Torre de Juan Abad](https://joinpearl.co/restaurants/torre-de-juan-abad/coto-de-quevedo-evolucion) offer comparable positioning in smaller regional cities. ### Quick Reference The takeBarmutet is best approached as a neighborhood anchor for casual hangouts and after-work meals where the local market calendar sets the tempo. It caters primarily to a resident clientele rather than tourists chasing spectacle, so dinners feel familiar and reliably good rather than theatrical. The restaurant's €€ price tier and consecutive Michelin Plate awards signal steady quality, making it a sensible choice for visitors who want authentic, market-driven Catalan cooking in Vic's medieval centre. Expect an accessible, convivial evening where simple provenance-led dishes take center stage. Opt for a selection of small plates or shared dishes to taste the restaurant's focus on provenance. Because the kitchen favors consistency over gimmicks, pick a few well-executed specialties and let the menu's market-driven components guide the meal. FAQ ## Frequently Asked Questions What should I order at Barmutet? Barmutet holds a Michelin Plate for both 2024 and 2025, which means the kitchen is executing traditional cuisine at a consistent, recognised standard. Stick to the dishes that lean into Catalan and Spanish classics — that is where the value sits at the €€ price point. The menu details are not published online, so ask the server what is prepared fresh that day rather than defaulting to whatever sounds familiar. Is Barmutet good for a special occasion? Yes, at €€ pricing with two consecutive Michelin Plates, Barmutet gives you a credible special-occasion option without the price pressure of a starred room. It works well for birthdays or anniversaries where you want recognised quality but not a three-hour tasting marathon. For a milestone that demands a bigger statement in Catalonia, El Celler de Can Roca in Girona is the step up — but expect a year-plus wait and a significantly higher bill. Is Barmutet good for solo dining? Traditional cuisine restaurants in Spain at the €€ range are generally comfortable for solo diners, and Barmutet's Michelin Plate recognition suggests a professional front-of-house capable of accommodating single covers without issue. Booking ahead is still the right move — walk-in availability for one is not confirmed. Solo diners who want bar-counter energy rather than a table-service format would find Vic's smaller bar-restaurant scene a better fit.

# Restaurante Ecuatoriano La Sazón de los Apolo

[Atrás](https://www.toppingsandsalads.es/restaurante/)

Ctra. de la Guixa, 10, 08500 Vic, Barcelona, España

Bar

8.4(2222 reseñas)

El Restaurante Ecuatoriano La Sazón de los Apolo se encuentra ubicado en la carretera de la Guixa número 10, en la ciudad de Vic, provincia de Barcelona. Este establecimiento se ha posicionado como una de las opciones más reconocidas para quienes buscan experimentar la gastronomía latinoamericana en la comarca de Osona, ofreciendo una propuesta que combina platos típicos ecuatorianos con preparaciones de otras cocinas de la región andina.

[Contacto](https://www.toppingsandsalads.es/contacto) [Llamar](tel:+34938073370) [Pagina Web](https://es-es.facebook.com/TriatecaVic/)

[Maps](about:invalid#zClosurez "Maps (opens in new tab)")

BESbswy

Con una calificación de 4,2 sobre 5 puntos y más de 800 reseñas acumuladas, este **restaurante latinoamericano en Vic** presenta un perfil heterogéneo en cuanto a opiniones de clientes. El nivel de precios se sitúa en un rango moderado, lo que lo convierte en una opción accesible para familias y grupos que desean disfrutar de comida latina sin realizar un desembolso elevado.

## Horario y servicios disponibles

El establecimiento abre sus puertas de martes a jueves desde las 9:00 hasta la medianoche, mientras que los viernes y sábados extiende su servicio hasta la 1:00 de la madrugada. Los domingos funciona en horario continuado de 9:00 a 23:00, permaneciendo cerrado los lunes. Esta amplitud horaria permite que funcione también como **bar y cafetería**, ofreciendo servicios de desayuno, brunch, almuerzo y cena.

Entre sus servicios destaca la posibilidad de realizar pedidos para llevar, contando además con servicio de entrega a domicilio y opción de reservas. El restaurante dispone de acceso para personas con movilidad reducida, lo que lo hace inclusivo para todo tipo de comensales.

## Propuesta gastronómica

La carta del restaurante incluye una variada selección de platos que van desde los clásicos ecuatorianos hasta preparaciones peruanas. Entre las opciones más destacadas por los clientes se encuentran el **encebollado**, considerado uno de los platos emblema de la gastronomía ecuatoriana, el **ceviche**, los **bolones mixtos** y las **empanadas** rellenas de pollo o ternera. También se pueden encontrar opciones como el hornado con chifles, la salchipapa, tamales, arroz con camarones, chuzo con patacones, sudados de pescado y chaufa.

Los clientes que han valorado positivamente el establecimiento destacan especialmente la abundancia de las raciones, mencionando que los platos son de tamaño XXL y que muchas veces sobraba comida para llevar. Los zumos naturales y las micheladas también reciben mención favorable por parte de quienes han visitado el local, considerándolos frescos y bien preparados.

No obstante, es importante señalar que varios clientes, especialmente aquellos de origen ecuatoriano, han expresado que determinados platos no alcanzan la autenticidad esperada. El encebollado, en particular, ha recibido críticas por parte de comensales de Guayaquil que consideran que no tiene el sabor tradicional, mencionando que los sabores se mezclan incorrectamente y que falta el toque característico de este plato típico.

## Puntos a favor según las opiniones

Entre los aspectos positivos más mencionados por los clientes se encuentran:

- **Relación calidad-precio favorable**: Muchos comensales coinciden en que los precios son razonables considerando la cantidad de comida que se sirve
- **Raciones generosas**: Las porciones son descritas como enormes, ideales para compartir o para personas con buen apetito
- **Variedad en el menú**: La combinación de propuestas ecuatorianas y peruanas ofrece opciones diversas
- **Buen ambiente**: Algunos clientes describen el local como acogedor y con decoración temática agradable
- : Varios reseñadores destacan la amabilidad de determinados miembros del personal, mencionando específicamente a camareras como Estefanía

## Aspectos a mejorar según las reseñas

El área más conflictiva del establecimiento, según las opiniones recopiladas, es el servicio. Son numerosas las reseñas que critican la lentitud en la atención, mencionando esperas de hasta 45 minutos o más para recibir los platos. También se reportan problemas de coordinación entre el personal, situaciones donde se olvidan pedidos, y una falta de comunicación entre las camareras que atiende diferentes mesas.

Algunas experiencias mencionan actitudes poco profesionales por parte de empleados, incluyendo respuestas prepotentes ante reclamaciones, falta de empatía y, en casos aislados, problemas de higiene personal del personal de sala. Varios clientes también señalan que el baño presentaba condiciones deficientes durante sus visitas.

En cuanto a la calidad de la comida, las críticas se centran principalmente en la preparación de ciertos platos. Clientes mencionan que algunos alimentos llegaban fríos, que el arroz daba muestras de haber sido recalentado, y que en ocasiones la frescura de los ingredientes no era la adecuada. Un cliente incluso reportó haber encontrado comida en mal estado, situación que resultó en una experiencia muy negativa.

También hay reseñas que señalan una aparente reducción en las cantidades servidas con el paso del tiempo, manteniendo precios similares o incluso aumentados, lo que ha generado descontento entre clientes habituales.

## Recomendaciones para visitar el establecimiento

Si decides visitar este **restaurante en Vic**, es advisable tener en cuenta algunas consideraciones. Los fines de semana y durante eventos especiales, como la feria medieval que se celebra en la ciudad, el local suele llenarse considerablemente, lo que puede afectar la calidad del servicio. Muchos clientes recomiendan посещение en días y horarios con menor afluencia para disfrutar de una experiencia más pausada.

Para personas con restricciones alimentarias, como celiaquía, es importante mencionar que varios clientes han reportado falta de información sobre alérgenos y respuestas inadecuadas ante consultas sobre la composición de los platos.

Si buscas específicamente comida ecuatoriana auténtica, quizás debas comunicar tus expectativas al personal o estar preparado para una propuesta que fusiona varios estilos latinoamericanos más que para una experiencia gastronómica estrictamente tradicional.

## Consideraciones finales

El **Restaurante Ecuatoriano La Sazón de los Apolo** representa una opción válida para quienes buscan **comer comida latina en Vic** y sus alrededores. Sus puntos fuertes radican en las raciones abundantes, los precios accesibles y la variedad del menú, además de contar con un horario amplio que incluye servicio nocturno los fines de semana.

Sin embargo, la inconsistencia en la calidad del servicio y algunas experiencias negativas relacionadas con la preparación de los platos invitan a ser cautos. La recomendación general es visitar el establecimiento con expectativas realistas, preferring días de menor ocupación y, si es posible, solicitar recomendaciones específicas al personal sobre los platos mejor preparados según la temporada.

Para pedidos de comida para llevar o servicio a domicilio, es recomendable confirmar todos los detalles del pedido antes de confirmar la compra, incluyendo cubiertos y acompañamientos, para evitar inconvenientes posteriores.
